protocol.selection: Exclude all IDs in historical checked-in results and repair plans, including listed reserves. Sort remaining single-function Alive2 miscompilation cases by reproducer lines then numeric ID, divide into thirds, order each third by SHA-256 of protocol ID + colon + bug ID, round-robin components, take the first 16 candidates per tier in that order. Take the first 8 eligible, with duplicate fresh pair hashes skipped within or across tiers.

comparison.endpoint: fraction of original instructions removed with fresh verification
comparison.test: two-sided exact paired sign test of the instruction-count difference, alpha=0.05

  %x.bc = bitcast <2 x i64> %x to <4 x i32>

  %sel = select <4 x i1> %cmp, <4 x i32> %sub.bc, <4 x i32> zeroinitializer
  ret <4 x i32> %sel
}
